authority.name: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs (policy); visas are issued by the consulate of the Schengen country of main destination

data.notes: The Schengen area has 29 countries: 25 EU Member States (Bulgaria and Romania joined fully on 1 January 2025) plus Iceland, Norway, Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Cyprus takes part in Schengen cooperation, but internal border controls have not yet been lifted. Ireland is not in Schengen. Short stays are limited to 90 days in any 180-day period. You apply at the consulate of the country of main destination: the longest stay, or the first entry if the stays are equal. The Entry/Exit System (EES) records non-EU short-stay travellers' fingerprints and facial images at the external border. Its rollout began on 12 October 2025 and it has been fully operational since 10 April 2026. ETIAS is only for visa-exempt travellers, so it does not replace the visa Indians need. The visa requirement for Indians is confirmed by the German missions in India; the EU page itself points to Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806.

data.notes: The Georgia e-visa portal returns for citizens of India (portal country id 443): visa needed = yes, single entry, stay up to 30 days, validity 120 days, fee USD 20 (the FAQ also mentions a 2% service fee). Study (D3), work (D1) and family (D4) immigration visas are applied for at a Georgian embassy, not through the e-visa portal; work visas need a Georgian work permit first. The document lists for D1/D3/D4 below were read on the MFA page of the Embassy in Jordan (jordan.mfa.gov.ge): the checklists are national MFA categories, but the New Delhi embassy's own procedure, fees and appointment process were not confirmed. data.advisory: MEA travel advisory of 12 Apr 2024 advised Indians not to travel to Iran or Israel until further notice (check mea.gov.in for any newer advisory; this was the latest Israel-specific one found). MEA (Dec 2023) warned that unregistered agents run fake overseas job offers and named Israel among the destinations; use only recruiting agents listed on emigrate.gov.in and note the Emigration Act service-charge cap of Rs 30,000 + GST. MEA parliamentary answers (Feb 2024) state Israel is NOT among the 18 ECR countries, so eMigrate registration is not mandatory for Israel. The Indian Embassy in Tel Aviv runs a 24-hour helpline (+972 3-522-6748 shown as emergency number on its homepage).
data.notes: Indian passport holders residing in India can apply for the eVisa-B2 tourist visa directly on the PIBA site (embassy announcement 11/07/2025). All other visas (A/2 student, B/1 work, B/1 expert, B/1 caregiver) go through the Israel Visa Application Centres, and B/1 work visas need prior approval from Israel's Population and Immigration Authority (employer applies in Israel). India-Israel Framework Agreement and Implementation Protocols on temporary employment of Indian workers (construction, caregiving) were signed in Nov 2023. During PM Modi's Feb 2026 visit, further Implementation Protocols on Labour Mobility were signed for commerce and services, manufacturing, and restaurant sectors (details of eligibility and recruitment channel not found).

visaCentreIndia.name: VFS Global (Schengen visas)

data.notes: Long stays need an MVV (provisional residence permit), usually applied for by a recognised sponsor (employer or university) together with the residence permit. After the IND's positive decision, collect the MVV sticker within 3 months at the Embassy in New Delhi or the Consulates-General in Mumbai or Bangalore. Processing takes up to 10 working days, the passport must be valid 6+ months with 2 empty pages, and DTDC courier costs INR 850. Schengen visas are filed at VFS Global centres in Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Chandigarh, Chennai, Cochin, Hyderabad, Jalandhar, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Pune and New Delhi. 2026 salary thresholds (gross per month, without holiday pay): HSM 30+ EUR 5,942; HSM under 30 EUR 4,357; reduced HSM criterion EUR 3,122; EU Blue Card EUR 5,942 (reduced EUR 4,754). 'Visa required' is inferred from the embassy's Schengen visa process for India.

eligibility.label: One of three routes
eligibility.detail: (1) Deficit notice / partial recognition notice, plus registration for the required measure (theory course, practical measure with employer, knowledge test, or German course of at least 18 hours/week). (2) Recognition partnership (Anerkennungspartnerschaft): ZAB confirmation that the training is state-approved, the employer's Employment Declaration and Appendix A, and a written agreement to start recognition and complete measures within 3 years of entry. data.licensing: Nursing (general nurse / Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann) is regulated in Germany. Recognition is required before practising, and is decided by the competent state authority (for example the Landesamt für Arbeitsschutz, Verbraucherschutz und Gesundheit in Brandenburg). If the training is not equivalent, the applicant can choose an adaptation period or a knowledge test. Applications can be made from abroad. The portal states a decision within 4 months of a complete file at the latest. Recognition normally takes 3–4 months, or 2 months under the employer-initiated accelerated procedure.

eligibility.label: Category A sponsor (Irish citizen)
eligibility.detail: No waiting period. Gross income over and above State benefits of at least €75,000 cumulative over the 3 years before applying (e.g. €25,000 a year).

eligibility.label: Category B sponsor (Critical Skills permit holders, intra-company transferees, full-time non-locum doctors, researchers, STEP/IIP, KASP, PhD students, ministers of religion)
eligibility.detail: Spouse/partner and minor children can apply immediately and accompany on arrival; other family members after 2 years. Family members of CSEP holders get Stamp 1G (work without a permit).

eligibility.detail: Spouse/partner and minor children after the sponsor has been legally working in Ireland for 1 year; others after 5 years. Gross income over €30,000 in the previous year; with minor children, net income above the Working Family Payment limits (2026 indicative gross: €50,200 for 1 child, €60,200 for 2, €70,100 for 3).

eligibility.label: Dependent adult relatives (all categories)
eligibility.detail: Must first apply for Stamp 0 from outside the State; sponsor needs gross income in Ireland in each of the previous 3 years above €96,929 (1 adult), €130,985 (2), €165,042 (3) for 2026.

eligibility.label: Suitable accommodation
eligibility.detail: May be requested by the decision-maker; e.g. one extra bedroom per two children; RTB-registered tenancy and ACCOM1 form if renting.

eligibility.label: Ineligible sponsors
eligibility.detail: Students (except Category B PhD/KASP), Third Level Graduate Programme (Stamp 1G) graduates, temporary protection beneficiaries; UK and EU nationals use separate schemes.

data.processing: DETE (as of 23 October 2026) was processing new General Employment Permit applications received on 20 September 2026. Embassy New Delhi employment visas: Category A 4-6 weeks, Category B 8-10 weeks.

occupations.note: Healthcare/home support roles (SOC 6145) are not on the IOL and use the lower €32,691 threshold; Support Worker and Home Support Services quotas renewed in May 2026. Senior care workers (6146) are ineligible except in disability services; care escorts ineligible.

HGV drivers with CE/C1E licence and bus/coach drivers with D/DE/D1/D1E licence are excepted from the IOL. Van drivers, taxi/cab drivers, fork-lift drivers, driving instructors and train/tram drivers are ineligible.

Chefs are ineligible except Executive/Head/Sous Chef (5 years' experience) and Chef de Partie/Commis Chef (2 years), not in fast-food outlets. Cooks, waiters, bar staff, kitchen and catering assistants, housekeepers are ineligible.

Elementary construction occupations and road/rail construction operatives are ineligible. Plastic lining technicians, steel fixers, fencing operators/erectors and curtain wallers are excepted; concrete pump operators also eligible.
Process operatives are ineligible except meat processor operatives, seafood operatives and CNC operatives; packers, storage and assembly routine operatives are ineligible.
Farm workers ineligible except dairy and pig farm assistants; horticulture workers excepted (lower threshold applies); horticultural trades and gardeners ineligible.
Most health roles not on the IOL; many are on the CSOL (Critical Skills permit preferred).
Nursery nurses, childminders, teaching and educational support assistants are on the IOL.

data.notes: Initial permit up to 2 years, renewable for up to a further 3 years. Spouses/partners of GEP holders are not eligible for a Dependant Employment Permit and need their own permit (but can be Category C family reunification beneficiaries with Stamp 1G under the June 2026 policy). May 2026 review (32 occupations) removed several roles from the IOL and added quotas for fish filleters and seafood operatives.

eligibility.detail: At least 30 hours a week; permanent or fixed-term for at least 12 months, or contracts of at least 6 months; meets the pay requirement of the pathway.

eligibility.label: Points-based pathway: 6 skilled resident points
eligibility.detail: 3 to 6 points from one category (qualification, NZ occupational registration or income), plus up to 3 points from skilled work experience in New Zealand (1 year = 1, 1.5 years = 2, 2 years = 3).

eligibility.label: Qualification points
eligibility.detail: Doctoral = 6. International Master's = 5, Honours/Postgraduate Diploma/Certificate = 4, Bachelor's = 4, and an International Qualification Assessment (IQA) from NZQA is needed unless on the List of Qualifications Exempt from Assessment. No points for non-degree level 7 or below.

eligibility.label: Income points
eligibility.detail: 3 times the SMC wage threshold (currently NZD 105.00 an hour) = 6 points; 2 times = 4 points; 1.5 times = 3 points.

eligibility.label: Skilled Work Experience pathway
eligibility.detail: Job at ANZSCO skill level 1 to 3 paid at least 1.1 times the SMC wage threshold; 3 years of relevant experience plus 2 years of skilled work experience in New Zealand. Amber List jobs have extra requirements; Red List and skill level 4 to 5 jobs are not eligible.

eligibility.label: Trades and Technician pathway
eligibility.detail: Eligible trades or technician occupation paid at least the SMC wage threshold; relevant qualification at level 4 or above; 2.5 years post-qualification experience plus 1.5 years skilled work experience in New Zealand. International qualifications need an NZQA IQA.
